prompt_preview:
PROCESS TO DOCUMENT:
New travel agencies sign up as partners and need to be onboarded: verify their business registration, set their credit limit and payment terms, create their portal logins, run a walkthrough of how to book, and hand them to an account owner. Right now this is tracked in a spreadsheet, steps get skipped, and agents sometimes get portal access before their credit terms are agreed
system_preview:
You write standard operating procedures for the operations team of a B2B travel company. Their customers are travel agents who book flights, hotels, and holiday packages on behalf of travellers.

Write the SOP an experienced operations lead would write:

value.title: Travel Agency Partner Onboarding Procedure
value.purpose: Standardize the end-to-end onboarding of newly registered travel agencies, ensuring business verification, credit risk evaluation, portal access control, and platform training are completed within five business days without skipping required compliance gates.
value.scope: Applies to all newly registered B2B travel agency accounts handled by the Agent Partnerships department from initial application receipt through account transfer to the Account Manager.
prerequisites: Completed travel agency registration form submitted via partner portal
Government-issued business registration certificate and tax identification documents
Assigned Partner Operations Associate and designated Account Manager

procedure.instruction: Retrieve the travel agency application and verify the validity of the business registration documents against official government registry databases.
procedure.expected_result: Business registration status, tax ID, and legal business name are confirmed valid and documented in the onboarding log.

procedure.instruction: Submit the verified business profile to the credit team to perform a financial risk evaluation and establish approved credit limits and payment terms.
procedure.expected_result: A formal credit limit decision and payment terms (e.g., prepay, 7-day, or 14-day credit) are issued in writing by the Finance team.

procedure.instruction: Issue the Credit Agreement and Terms of Business to the agency contact and obtain a signed copy prior to granting portal access.
procedure.expected_result: A fully executed, signed credit agreement is received and uploaded to the partner profile.

procedure.instruction: Create administrative portal login credentials for the agency in the booking platform and send the account activation email.
procedure.expected_result: Portal credentials are generated and the agency administrator receives activation instructions only after credit terms are signed.

procedure.instruction: Schedule and execute a live platform walkthrough session with the travel agency staff, covering flight, hotel, and package booking workflows.
procedure.expected_result: Walkthrough session completed and confirmed via signed or email-acknowledged training sign-off sheet.

procedure.instruction: Transfer the account record to the assigned Account Manager in the CRM and conduct a formal handover summary.
procedure.expected_result: Account ownership is updated in the system, and the Account Manager acknowledges receipt of the active account.

decision_points.question: Are the agency's business registration documents valid and active in official government databases?
decision_points.if_yes: Proceed to Step 2 for financial evaluation and credit limit assignment.
decision_points.if_no: Reject application or request updated registration documents from the agency before proceeding.

decision_points.question: Has the signed credit agreement and terms of business been returned by the agency?
decision_points.if_yes: Proceed to Step 4 to create portal login credentials.
decision_points.if_no: Hold step 4; do not create portal credentials until the signed agreement is received.

exceptions.situation: Agency requests urgent portal login access before returning signed credit terms.
exceptions.action: Refuse credential generation until the agreement is signed. Offer a temporary prepay/read-only demo environment if available, but do not issue active booking credentials.

exceptions.situation: Finance / Credit team rejects credit limit application due to insufficient credit history.
exceptions.action: Set account payment terms to 'Pre-payment / Deposit basis' only, send amended agreement to agency, and update partner profile.

exceptions.situation: Agency fails to attend scheduled booking platform walkthrough session.
exceptions.action: Reschedule walkthrough within 24 hours and send self-service video onboarding materials; do not mark step 5 complete until live or confirmed self-service training is verified.

escalation_rules.trigger: Business verification or document authenticity cannot be verified within 24 hours.
Agency refuses standard credit terms or demands custom contract terms.
Onboarding total elapsed time reaches 4 business days without completion.

checklist: Business registration and tax status verified against government registry
Credit evaluation completed and limit/terms assigned by Finance
Signed Credit Agreement and Terms of Business uploaded to account profile
Portal admin login credentials created (only after contract execution)
Platform booking walkthrough conducted and training sign-off recorded
Account transferred and accepted by assigned Account Manager

kpis.name: End-to-End Onboarding Time
kpis.how_measured: Time elapsed from initial application submission to final account transfer recorded in onboarding tracking system

kpis.name: Onboarding Gate Compliance Rate
kpis.how_measured: Percentage of onboarded accounts with verified business docs and signed credit terms prior to credential creation

kpis.name: Early Access Violation Rate
kpis.how_measured: Count of portal logins created before signed credit terms are uploaded, audited weekly

risks.description: Issuing portal login credentials prior to credit term agreement exposes business to unbacked financial liabilities.
risks.mitigation: Systematically enforce credential creation gated by signed agreement verification.

risks.description: Manual spreadsheet tracking allows steps to be skipped or miscommunicated across teams.
risks.mitigation: Require mandatory step sign-offs in sequential workflow log before advancing to the next step.

improvement_suggestions: Replace manual spreadsheet tracking with an automated workflow management system featuring mandatory gate checks.
Implement electronic signature integration to automatically trigger portal provisioning upon contract signature.
Automate business registration verification via direct API integrations with national corporate registries.
